records.rationale: The mechanism is verifiable in the diff: group.js findMembers fires an async Discourse.ajax and in the .then handler unconditionally calls self.setProperties({user_count, limit, offset, members}) from the server response. Nothing in the controller's next/previous actions (admin-group.js) or the model cancels a prior in-flight request when a new one starts (e.g., no request-id guard or promise chaining on the model).
